input.answer:
Regular self-serve gas was cheaper in Toronto in September 2026. Toronto averaged 183.7 cents per litre and Vancouver 209.5 cents per litre, so Toronto was 25.8 cents/L cheaper (209.5 − 183.7 = 25.8). Vancouver's price was about 14.0% higher than Toronto's (25.8 ÷ 183.7 = 14.0%).

For context, August 2026 was Toronto 170.3 and Vancouver 206.7 cents/L. Toronto rose 13.4 cents (183.7 − 170.3, +7.9%) and Vancouver rose 2.8 cents (209.5 − 206.7, +1.4%).

Units: the table reports prices in cents per litre, and the tool returned the values with scalar_factor "units", so I used them as published.
